description: Hand-authored synthetic public posts, accounts and reader bookmarks for three storylines from Saturday to Monday, Oct. 10-12, 2026 (fictional): a late-night train cancellation, a county wildfire, and two analysts' readings of one company's shipment figure. Includes one rendered station-board image. Not a benchmark task.

sources.description: Original fictional text authored for this package by @byshail. All accounts, people, places, agencies, companies, posts and links are invented; no external posts, articles or alerts were collected, translated or adapted.

Original image rendered for this package by @byshail with tests/board-image.cjs (shared by dev/build-fixtures.cjs and the business tests) from the two text lines quoted in the post's alt text. In the story the rider posts it as a cropped photo; it is a rendering, and no photograph, screenshot or external asset was used.

transformations: The second reader's seed (examples/task-data) is the minimal seed plus examples/scenario.json and examples/wildfire-events.json, with a different account and bookmarks.
The board image's pixels are a deterministic rendering of its alt-text lines; tests decode the PNG and compare.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, image legibility, variation and reuse permissions.
